meta.title: Rank Based: minimum revisions before rank is shown

steps.note: Open the single-stage create flow required for configuring a rank-based auction.
Configure the event as a rank-based auction awarded as a whole lot.

args.goal: on the rank-based auction configuration screen, enable "Set Minimum revision to show Rank" and enter 2 in its revision input; stop when the setting is visibly enabled with the value 2

steps.note: No catalog domain step sets the minimum-revision rank setting, so perform this buyer-side configuration directly on the screen.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the auction bid sheet.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Invite one vendor whose portal session will submit and revise the bid.
Verify the event reached a published project page before bidding.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the auction's vendor pricing sheet.
Submit the initial vendor price; this establishes the bid before any revision.
Assert that rank is hidden before the vendor has made the required revisions.
Submit the first revision, which is still fewer than the configured two revisions.
Assert that rank remains hidden after only one revision.
Submit the second revision to reach the configured minimum.
Assert that the vendor portal now shows rank after at least two revisions.
